title: Fix a CrashLooping Deployment
prompt:
The Deployment `web` in namespace `cka-ts-crashloop` is repeatedly crashing and entering `CrashLoopBackOff`.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Troubleshoot and fix the workload so its Pod becomes `Running` and `Ready`.
2. Keep the container image `nginx:1.27-alpine` unchanged.

manifests:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: cka-ts-crashloop
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginx:1.27-alpine
        command: ["sh", "-c", "exit 1"]

checks.description: Pod of Deployment `web` is Running and Ready
checks.failure_hint: The container exits immediately. Inspect `kubectl -n cka-ts-crashloop logs <pod>` and fix the container command.
Do not change the image; fix only the container command.

checks.description: Deployment `web` reports at least 1 available replica
checks.failure_hint: No replica is available yet — the Pod must become Ready first.

reference_solution:
The container command is overridden with `exit 1`.
```bash
kubectl -n cka-ts-crashloop patch deployment web --type=json -p='[{"op":"remove","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/command"}]'
```
hints: Check Pod termination reason and logs via `k -n cka-ts-crashloop describe pod` and `k -n cka-ts-crashloop logs`.
Inspect the container `command` / `args` override inside Deployment `web` and restore normal nginx startup.
fast_solution_commands: k -n cka-ts-crashloop get deploy web -o yaml
